prompts.title: 使用 Nano Banana 2 生成暗黑奇幻骑士壁纸
prompts.description: 一个为 Nano Banana 2 设计的详细图像生成提示，旨在创作一张超现实的 8k 暗黑奇幻壁纸，画面中一位身披精细钢甲、饱经战火的骑士正走过一片金色的草地。该提示详细说明了电影般的镜头设置、光照和氛围。
prompts.content: A cinematic, full-body shot of a battle-worn knight in detailed steel plate armor walking through a tall, golden grass field. The knight is draped in heavily tattered and shredded bright red robes that flow in the wind, with a longsword in hand and a secondary blade strapped to his back. A flock of black crows circles in the hazy, overcast sky above. Soft, diffused daylight creates a moody atmosphere with visible dust motes and particles. Shot on a Sony A7R IV with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, low angle, shallow depth of field focusing on the intricate textures of the weathered armor and frayed fabric. Hyper-realistic, 8k resolution, raw photo, gritty dark fantasy aesthetic, 9 : 16.

prompts.title: 电影公路旅行拼贴画，保留身份信息
prompts.description: 一个提示，指示模型创建一个 2x2 的拼贴画，包含四个电影般的旅行生活场景，其中有相同的男人、汽车和一致的氛围。它强调在所有四个画面中，都要保留参考照片中提供的精确面部特征、发型和服装。
prompts.content: using the attached reference photos as the identity and wardrobe source for the man, preserve the exact same facial features, face geometry, hairstyle and clothing from the references, create a photorealistic 2x2 collage of four cinematic travel lifestyle scenes with consistent color grading and atmosphere, as if shot on the same camera during one road trip. the same car model appears in all frames, matching color and interior. frame 1: man stepping out of the car on a mountain overlook at sunset, one hand on the open door, wind in hair, looking into the distance over clouds. frame 2: man sitting in the open trunk of the same car, playing an acoustic guitar, relaxed posture, warm autumn light, cozy blankets inside trunk. frame 3: interior car view from back seat, man driving, eyes visible in rearview mirror, one hand adjusting mirror, road glowing in golden light ahead. frame 4: man standing on a forest trail with backpack, looking up at tall trees, soft mist and green tones. natural cinematic lighting, cohesive warm earthy palette, subtle film grain, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture with minimal professional retouching, lifestyle photography, 50mm lens look, f/2.8, no text, no watermark
prompts.translatedContent: 以所附参考照片作为该男子的身份和服装来源，保留参考照片中完全相同的面部特征、面部几何结构、发型和服装，创作一个由四幅电影感旅行生活场景组成的 2x2 拼贴画，色彩分级和氛围保持一致，仿佛是在同一次公路旅行中用同一台相机拍摄的。所有画面中都出现同一款车型，颜色和内饰也保持一致。画面 1：男子在日落时分从车中走出，站在山顶观景台，一只手扶着开着的车门，头发随风飘扬，眺望远方云海。画面 2：男子坐在同一辆车的后备箱里，弹奏着原声吉他，姿态放松，暖暖的秋日阳光，后备箱内铺着舒适的毯子。画面 3：从后座看车内，男子正在开车，后视镜中可见他的眼睛，一只手正在调整后视镜，前方的道路在金色光芒中闪耀。画面 4：男子背着背包站在森林小径上，仰望着高大的树木，弥漫着柔和的薄雾和绿色调。自然的电影感光线，统一的暖色大地色系，细微的胶片颗粒感，浅景深，逼真的皮肤纹理，极少的专业修饰，生活方式摄影，50mm 镜头效果，f/2.8，无文字，无水印。

Background: minimal, abstract ink wash or neutral tone to simulate newspaper editorial layout. Lighting: cinematic soft light with subtle rim highlights to add depth. Rendering style: mix of hand-drawn ink illustration and polished digital painting.
